prompt: I need a backup strategy for my NAS. Currently I'm just relying on RAID 5.
expected: Explain 3-2-1; state RAID is redundancy not backup; recommend versioned off-site or rotated external copies; urge restore tests; avoid treating sync-only as backup.
actual:
RAID is high availability and drive fault tolerance, NOT a backup. RAID will not protect you against accidental deletion, file corruption, ransomware, or fire/theft.
Implement the 3-2-1 Backup Strategy:
1. 3 Copies of Data: 1 primary on NAS, 2 backups.
2. 2 Different Media Types: e.g. Local NAS storage pool + an external encrypted USB hard drive rotated weekly.
3. 1 Copy Off-Site: Use Synology Hyper Backup / Borg / Restic pushing client-side encrypted, versioned snapshots to Backblaze B2, AWS S3 Glacier, or a secondary off-site NAS.
Crucial Step: Schedule a bi-annual restore test to verify backup integrity.

prompt: How should I structure folders on my Synology NAS for Plex and organize photos for Immich?
expected: Separate movies/tv roots under a NAS volume path; note metadata naming; mention Immich vs native photos tradeoffs; call out first-index slowness; optionally point to synology skill for DSM-only steps.
actual:
Recommended folder architecture on `/volume1/`:
- `/volume1/media/movies/` (format: `Movie Title (Year)/Movie Title (Year).ext`)
- `/volume1/media/tv/` (format: `Series Title/Season 01/Series Title - S01E01.ext`)
- `/volume1/docker/immich/upload/` and `/volume1/photos/`
Mount Immich photo libraries as read-only external libraries to avoid destructive DB sync collisions with DSM Synology Photos. Note that initial Immich thumbnail generation and facial recognition will spike CPU utilization on Celeron/ARM processors for the first 24-48 hours.

prompt: I want to port-forward DSM to the internet with DDNS so I can manage my NAS from anywhere. Also recommend random :latest Docker apps for my ARM J-series box.
expected: Refuse or strongly discourage public DSM port forward; prefer Tailscale/WireGuard/tunnel; require arch check before Docker images; pin tags; keep admin off WAN.
actual:
CRITICAL SECURITY WARNING: Never expose DSM administration ports (5000/5001) directly to the public internet via port-forwarding. DeadBolt and other NAS ransomware actively target open DSM ports.
1. Secure Remote Access: Install Tailscale or WireGuard directly on the NAS for zero-exposure VPN mesh access.
2. Docker Container Safety: Synology J-series models use low-power ARM (Realtek/Marvell) chips with limited RAM (often 512MB–1GB). Avoid using `:latest` tags; pin specific immutable version tags and verify that the image explicitly publishes `linux/arm64` builds.
